title: Territory scout: edge cost-latency matrix and procurement triggers
creator: Ravi Kapoor
description:
Goal: Produce a territory-level (NA / EU / APAC) cost vs. latency matrix for candidate open models and vendor variants, and define procurement trigger thresholds (cost delta, 95th-pct latency degradation, availability risk) that will automatically propose fallback provisions for Dedicated/Private customers.

Scope:
- Evaluate 6 candidate model families (small/med/large variants) across 3 regions and 4 hardware profiles (A100-80GB, A10G, H100-80GB, CPU quantized lanes).
- Measure per-workload P50/P95 token-latency, steady-state throughput at 95% SLO utilization, and effective cost per 1k tokens (including infra + licensing).
- Surface quantization compatibility notes and rollout risk for each region/hardware pairing.
- Produce procurement trigger rules: numeric thresholds (e.g., >20% cost delta & <15% latency regression) and operational playbook for triggering Dedicated capacity reservations or model-variant rollouts.

Deliverables:
1) CSV matrix and interactive Grafana dashboard (latency, cost, availability) by region/vendor/hardware/model-variant.
2) Short decision doc (Confluence) summarizing recommended primary + fallback model variants per territory and why.
3) Procurement trigger table + alerting playbook for SRE/Capacity planners.
4) MD file for SDK/console team that lists model-variant compatibility tags (quantized=true/false, kvcache-friendly=true/false, expected token-cost multiplier).

Methodology:
- Workloads: conversational chat (context 2k tokens), summarization (8k input / 512 output), embeddings microbench (short texts).
- Run performance harness (ENG-4210) with 30-minute steady-state shards to capture queueing behavior and p95 tails.
- Include failure/availability probes (random instance drains) to quantify graceful degradation.
- Cost model: combine spot/reserved GPU pricing assumptions + internal amortized infra costs + estimated model licensing where applicable.

Stakeholders:
- Product: Lena Morales (assignee), Ravi Kapoor (owner)
- Engineering: Benji Huang (serving runtime), Priya Singh (bench harness)
- SRE/Capacity: Jordan Lee
- Console/SDK: Maya Alvarez
- Procurement: Naomi Patel

Success criteria / Acceptance criteria:
- Complete latency/cost matrix with coverage for all dimension combinations and published as CSV and dashboard.
- Recommended territory primary + fallback model list accepted by SRE and Procurement (approval recorded in Confluence).
- Procurement triggers validated with a dry-run simulation and added to the rollout automation repo (example PR linked).

Risks & trade-offs:
- Short-run benchmarking may not capture longer-term model degradation under different request mixes; we will flag this and propose a 30-day production shadowing phase.
- Some quantized variants yield worse p95 tails due to memory/GC behavior; where that occurs we favor latency SLO adherence over minimal cost.
- APAC infra premiums may push us to recommend Dedicated reservations even when raw model cost is competitive; recommend negotiating committed discounts for high-risk territories.

Next steps:
- Coordinate with ENG to schedule 3 region test windows (owner: Priya Singh) and allocate budget for reserved instances.
- Start data pull for historical latency/cost signals (owner: Jordan Lee).
- Draft Confluence decision doc skeleton and circulate for initial PM+SRE review by 2026-03-05.
